content.title: Increase Pundi X Chain max validator to 50
content.description:
This proposal will increase maximum validator count from the original max 20 to 50. It is the first max validator increase since the launch of Pundi X Chain and will allow public-hosted validator to join and help secure the network.

Changes
1. 20 to 50 max validators.

Timeline:
Voting will last 7 days, if approved max validator will increase to 50.

Vote YES for: improvement changes.
Vote NO for: no improvement changes.

content.title: 4 Billion PURSE Airdrop to PUNDIX Holders on Upbit
content.description:
Background:

Upbit won the voting competition on Twitter against nine other centralized exchanges with the highest PUNDIX trading volume. The PURSE airdrop final decision will be determined by the governance voting. 

The team proposed Upbit as the airdrop recipient for several reasons:

- Upbit has consistently had the largest trading volume for the past few years.
- Previously, Upbit did not receive the PURSE airdrop.
- Upbit is one of the largest holders of PUNDIX tokens, meaning that the majority of PUNDIX holders are trading and holding tokens on Upbit. https://etherscan.io/token/0x0fd10b9899882a6f2fcb5c371e17e70fdee00c38?a=0x2bc8e0130319b206aace6f41e28fd0cb3c2a2960

Once the proposal passed the governance voting, Pundi X team will notify Upbit and the PUNDIX snapshot will kick start after the exchange confirmed the airdrop.

Proposal Medium Link: https://medium.com/pursetoken/purse-airdrop-for-pundix-holders-and-erc-20-support-ef8bd06addcf

content.title: Burn 10 Billion PURSE token BEP20 in support of PURSE ERC404 community development
content.description:
PURSE has announced the introduction of ERC-404 for its development, marking a significant leap forward in the evolution of web3 loyalty rewards. In alignment with our commitment to the community and the future development of PURSE ERC404, the team proposes a burn of 10 billion BEP20 PURSE tokens (13.6% of the total supply). 

This innovative token standard, ERC404, ingeniously merges the properties of ERC20 fungible tokens and ERC721 non-fungible tokens (NFTs), creating a new class of assets that are both fungible and non-fungible depending on their state. By incorporating elements of both, PURSE ERC404 tokens offer unparalleled versatility and utility, catering to a wide range of use cases within the decentralized finance (DeFi) ecosystem.

This strategic token burn of BEP20 tokens and the adoption of ERC404 tokens align perfectly with our dedication to project growth and community involvement. This action potentially increases the utility of PURSE tokens as well as reduces the total supply. 

We invite our community to engage in the upcoming vote on this proposal and join us as we shape the future of PURSE within the ERC404 framework. Stay tuned for further updates as we continue to innovate and push the boundaries of what is possible with digital assets.

content.title: Battle Royale Event for PURSE+ Launch
content.description:
**Proposal Overview**

It is time to get more crypto users to join the PUNDIX and PURSE communities. To support the official launch of the PURSE+ browser plugin, we propose the execution of a $PURSE token budget totaling 253.25 million $PURSE tokens through a unique event titled "Battle Royale'' which will be engaging the social media influencers to use this product. The PURSE+ browser plugin, pioneering a SocialFi realm by blending social interactions with crypto rewards, had seen an unprecedented surge of over 12,000 users during a soft launch on 15 March 2024. Currently, the soft launch contributes to the success of making PURSE one of the Top 3 ERC404 tokens by market cap at Coingecko. 

The official event, running from 1 April - 31 May 2024, aims to enhance blockchain utility, foster community engagement, and significantly boost the marketing and user adoption of PURSE+.

**Allocation Breakdown**

The total allocation for the Battle Royale event is detailed below:

Grand Prize (Team): 100,000,000

Grand Prize (Team Leader): 50,000,000

Top Team (4 Weeks): 40,000,000

Top Leader (4 Weeks): 20,000,000

Top Inviter (4 Weeks): 24,000,000

Twitter Giveaways (4 Weeks): 4,000,000

Daily Tasks (61 Days): 15,250,000

**Total $PURSE Token Reward Pool: 253,250,000 $PURSE Tokens**

**Proposal Details**

This proposal aims to leverage the official launch of PURSE+ to:

1) Enhance Blockchain Utility: By integrating financial rewards with social interactions, we aim to showcase the practical utility of blockchain technology in everyday life.
2) Foster Community Engagement: Encourage active participation within the community through rewards and challenges, thus strengthening the ecosystem.
3) Boost Adoption: Drive awareness and user adoption of PURSE+ through incentivized marketing efforts.

content.title: Integration of Solana on XPOS
content.description:
**Objective:** 

To enable XPOS to accept and process transactions using cryptocurrencies from the Solana ecosystem, thereby expanding the range of digital assets available to XPOS merchants and customers.

**Proposal Summary:**

Solana has the fourth largest transaction value, following Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Binance Smart Chain. In 2024, Solana's transaction volume exceeded $1 billion USD per day. To increase transaction value for the XPOS merchants, we propose the integration of the Solana blockchain into XPOS. This integration will allow merchants to accept crypto payments and conduct crypto sales using cryptocurrencies within the Solana ecosystem. The adoption of Solana's blockchain is expected to expand the utility and flexibility of XPOS for both merchants and customers. This proposal seeks community's approval to commence the development and implementation process.

Moreover, Solana stands out with over $2.7 billion USD daily on-chain transactions in stablecoins based on the data on DefiLama. We expect to expand cryptocurrency support and broaden the array of digital currencies available to merchants and customers, enhancing the XPOS platform's versatility.

**Execution Plan**

Upon approval of the governance proposal, the XPOS team will integrate Solana support and make it available within two weeks.

content.title: $PURSE Market-Making Initiative from Kronos Research
content.description:
This proposal aims to improve $PURSE liquidity on centralized exchanges. Market makers provide buy/sell orders on either side of the midpoint, allowing users on exchanges to buy, sell, and trade the token more efficiently, giving greater confidence in the asset. 

In order to provide ample liquidity, Kronos Research is requesting a loan of 800,000,000 $PURSE tokens for 1 year. With this loan, Kronos Research can provide liquidity on 4 exchanges. Currently, the liquidity on these platforms is inconsistent.

Note: Kronos Research does not attempt to influence market price in either direction.

Upon the completion of the service period, Kronos can choose to return the PURSE tokens to PURSE treasury or purchase the tokens according to the following tranches (in stablecoins):

* Tranch 1: 400,000,000 PURSE at [BMP*] x 1.5

* Tranch 2: 400,000,000 PURSE at [BMP*] x 2

*BMP: TWAP(time-weighted average price) 30-days commencing on the date of the Market Making Services begin

**Kronos Background**

Kronos Research is a proprietary trading firm founded in 2018 that trades on average more than $5 billion USD per day across global platforms. In DeFi, Kronos Research is a leading designated market-maker on platforms like dYdX, Floor Protocol etc. Kronos Research also incubated WOO Network and Orderly Network.

**Execution Plan**

Upon approval of the governance proposal, the PURSE team will prepare to sign an agreement with Kronos Research to proceed with the initiative.

content.title: Pundi AIFX:  Merge Pundi X Chain with f(x)Core
content.description:
**Description:**

The purpose of this proposal is to merge Pundi X Chain and f(x)Core into Pundi AIFX. This merger aims to streamline our blockchain infrastructure and operations, allowing for seamless upgrades and enhanced functionality to embrace the multi-chain and Artificial Intelligence era. By combining the strengths of Pundi X Chain and f(x)Core, we can overcome current limitations and unlock new potential for innovation and growth.

**The new Pundi AIFX ecosystem will offer several key features designed to enhance our capabilities and streamline our operations:**

- **Chain Abstraction:**
Developers can deploy once on Pundi AIFX, and the app will run without code changes on other EVM and Cosmos-compatible chains via omnichain channels. For example, a developer can launch a DEX on Pundi AIFX, which will then support Base, BSC, Osmosis, and more.

- **AI-Focused DApps:**
Pundi AIFX will support AI-focused decentralized applications, including those that power Pundi Xs AI-powered Enterprise XPOS.

**PUNDIX token utilities:**

$PUNDIX tokenomics will remain unchanged.

While Pundi AIFX network will utilize $AIFX as gas fee, $PUNDIX will maintain its critical role, providing a variety of utilities that enhance user experience and network functionality.

**Execution Plan:**

If this proposal is approved, we will kick off the merger process, including further details about the Pundi X Chain retirement date and instructions for migrating assets to the new Pundi AIFX Chain.

If you have any questions about the Pundi X Chain merge, please join the discussion on the StarScan forum: https://forum.starscan.io/t/temperature-check-upgrade-f-x-core-and-rebrand-function-x-to-pundi-aifx/5966/123

content.title: PundiXChain Sunset and Full Migration to Ethereum
content.description:
This is the official governance proposal for the PundiXChain sunset and full migration to Ethereum. Estimated chain closure date: 1 March 2026.

From now until 1 March 2026, users must manually bridge their tokens out of the PundiXChain. This applies to all assets, including delegated tokens in PundiXChain.
